"DIAGNOSTIC REQUEST — AGENT HQ BUILD FAILURE

Before attempting another build, investigate why the AGENT HQ workflow is failing.

Repository: \"dannyleonards42-web/PlayGround\"
Issue: #3
Latest failed workflow: Run \"41216628400\"

Observed errors

1. OpenCode v2.2.5 installs successfully.
2. The workflow allocates OpenCode port \"38501\".
3. The local health check fails:
   \"curl: (7) Failed to connect to 127.0.0.1 port 38501\"
4. The named worker tunnel subsequently fails:
   \"Named worker tunnel start: HTTP 502\"
5. The workflow exits with code 1 before project generation begins.

Your diagnostic tasks

1. Inspect the failed workflow, job logs, reusable workflow configuration and relevant runtime scripts.
2. Determine why the OpenCode server is not becoming healthy on port \"38501\".
3. Investigate why \"worker-tunnel.mjs\" receives HTTP 502.
4. Check whether the tunnel failure is related to the OpenCode startup failure or is a separate infrastructure issue.
5. Verify whether connected OpenCode Console and OpenRouter account credentials are being loaded correctly. Do not expose, print or copy secret values.
6. Check for known runtime compatibility issues involving OpenCode v2.2.5, Node.js v24.22.1 and the OmGithub runner.
7. Identify whether the problem is in OmGithub infrastructure, workflow configuration, runtime startup or account authentication.

Safety and execution rules

- Diagnose first; do not immediately rerun the build.
- Do not modify repository files, workflow configurations, secrets or account settings without approval.
- Do not delete or overwrite existing project files or checkpoints.
- Do not expose credentials in logs or reports.
- Do not claim a fix unless it has been tested successfully.

Required report

Return:

- Confirmed root cause, if established.
- Evidence from the logs or source code.
- Any contributing issues.
- Recommended fix, with exact steps.
- Whether the fix requires OmGithub support or can be applied in our repository.
- What remains uncertain.

Do not start building AGENT HQ until this diagnostic report is complete.
"

# Diagnostic Report — AGENT HQ Build Failure (Run 41216628400)

## 1. Confirmed root cause

**The OpenCode server did not fail to start. It became healthy on port 38501.**

The workflow failed because `worker-tunnel.mjs start` treated a **single transient HTTP 502 from OmGithub’s tunnel-provisioning API** as fatal. That step exited 1, so every later step — Git identity, branch creation, project generation, OpenCode execution — was skipped.

In short:

- **Confirmed proximate cause:** unhandled `HTTP 502` from `https://omgithub.com/api/github/.../issues/3/tunnel`.
- **Not the cause:** OpenCode v2.2.5 startup, port allocation, Node.js v24.22.1, runner compatibility, or account authentication.
- **Ultimate cause of the 502:** not provable from client logs. Evidence points to an intermittent OmGithub/Cloudflare-side failure, not the runner.

---

## 2. Evidence

### 2.1 OpenCode did become healthy

From run `41216628400`, job `124582435686`:

```text
15:49:38.392  Allocated OpenCode port: 38501
15:49:38.399  curl: (7) Failed to connect to 127.0.0.1 port 38501 ...
15:49:39.661  real 0.21          ← install-console ran, which is after the health gate
15:49:41.998  Tunnel OpenCode, live source files, and final preview independently
```

The `curl: (7)` is **attempt 1 of a 45-attempt loop**. The workflow’s reusable definition retries every second:

```yaml
# denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-reusable.yml
for _ in {1..45}; do
  if curl ... "http://127.0.0.1:$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT/api/info" ... && \
     node -e '...version check...'; then healthy=true; break; fi
  sleep 1
done
[[ "$healthy" == true ]] || { echo 'OpenCode V2 server did not become healthy' >&2; exit 1; }
```

The fatal message **“OpenCode V2 server did not become healthy” never appears**. The next command after the health gate ran at `15:49:39.661`, about one second later. Therefore the server was healthy by then.

The same pattern appears in run `41209352571`:

```text
14:17:02.750  Allocated OpenCode port: 40445
14:17:02.755  curl: (7) Failed to connect to 127.0.0.1 port 40445 ...
14:17:05.450  Tunnel OpenCode, live source files, and final preview independently
```

So the port-38501 message is a **normal first-poll startup race**, not the failure.

### 2.2 The actual failure

```text
15:49:44.486  [timing] named worker tunnel start: 2135 ms
15:49:44.486  file:///.../scripts/worker-tunnel.mjs:15
15:49:44.487  Error: Named worker tunnel start: HTTP 502
15:49:44.534  Process completed with exit code 1
```

Source:

```js
// denaidark/OhMyGithub/scripts/worker-tunnel.mjs
const endpoint = `${env.OMGITHUB_ORIGIN || 'https://omgithub.com'}/api/github/${env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${env.TRIGGER_ISSUE_NUMBER}/tunnel`
...
const response = await request(endpoint, { method: 'POST', ... })
if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Named worker tunnel ${mode}: HTTP ${response.status}`)
```

There is **no retry**. The first non-2xx response aborts the entire job. The error also omits the response body, `cf-ray`, and `x-request-id`.

### 2.3 The 502 is intermittent, not a permanent configuration failure

Same repository, same pinned runtime:

| Run | Issue | Tunnel result | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| `41209352571` | #1 | HTTP 502 at `14:17:08Z` | failed at tunnel step |
| `41209440734` | #2 | tunnel started successfully at `14:18:26Z` | later failed on model quota |
| `41216628400` | #3 | HTTP 502 at `15:49:44Z` | failed at tunnel step |
| `41218607764` | #4 (this diagnostic run) | tunnel registered successfully at `16:14:08–11Z` | currently running |

Run #2 and the current diagnostic run prove the same workflow, runtime SHA, OpenCode version, Node version, and runner can provision the tunnel successfully. That rules out a deterministic configuration error.

### 2.4 Credentials were loaded correctly

From the failed run:

```text
15:49:06.221  Loaded 0 account secret(s); subscription auth: account.
```

That means the OmGithub account credential import succeeded and the account-backed auth path was active. In the current diagnostic run, the loaded auth file contains only provider identifiers:

```text
auth providers: opencode, openrouter
entry types:   openrouter=api, opencode=oauth
account imported providers: opencode, openrouter
consoleCredential present: true
```

No secret values were printed or copied.

Repository-level `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `OPENCODE_API_KEY`, and `OPENCODE_AUTH_CONTENT` were empty in the failed run. That did **not** cause this failure because account-level auth supplied both `opencode` and `openrouter`. The failed run never reached model execution, so OpenRouter quota/usability was not exercised.

### 2.5 Runtime compatibility

The failed job ran on:

```text
GitHub-hosted runner 2.338.2
Ubuntu 26.04.1
Node.js v24.22.1
OpenCode v2.2.5
```

The current diagnostic run confirms:

```text
opencode v2.2.5
server listening on http://127.0.0.1:42887
/api/info → {"version":"2.2.5", ...}
cloudflared → Registered tunnel connection
```

No evidence of an OpenCode v2.2.5 / Node 24 / Ubuntu 26.04 incompatibility. This was also **not** a self-hosted “OmGithub runner” problem; the job used GitHub’s `ubuntu-latest` image.

---

## 3. Contributing issues

1. **No retry/backoff in `worker-tunnel.mjs`.** A transient 502 is treated as permanent. The OhMyGithub wiki itself says to retry tunnel startup at most three times, but the implementation does not.
2. **Poor 502 diagnostics.** The script discards the response body, `cf-ray`, and `x-request-id`, so OmGithub support cannot correlate the failure to server logs.
3. **Misleading health-check logging.** The first expected `curl: (7)` is printed without “attempt 1/45” context and there is no “healthy” success line. This made the failure look like an OpenCode startup problem.
4. **Pinned runtime SHA.** Our workflow pins OhMyGithub at `3b460fef...`; a retry fix upstream will not reach this repository until the pinned refs are updated.
5. **Separate model-quota risk.** Run #2 later failed with “OpenCode free-model quota reached.” That is unrelated to this 502 but may block a future AGENT HQ build if quota is not available.

---

## 4. Recommended fix

### Immediate action — no code change

Do **not** modify repository files yet. When ready to retry:

1. Confirm OmGithub is responding:
   ```bash
   curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://omgithub.com/
   ```
2. Rerun only the failed job once:
   ```bash
   gh run rerun 41216628400 \
     --repo dannyleonards42-web/PlayGround \
     --failed
   ```
   Or start a fresh dispatch for issue 3:
   ```bash
   gh workflow run opencode.yml \
     --repo dannyleonards42-web/PlayGround \
     -f issue_number=3
   ```
3. If it fails again with 502, capture the exact time and ask OmGithub support to inspect that run. Do not keep rerunning blindly.

This is a **retry of a transient failure**, not a tested fix.

### Durable fix — requires OhMyGithub upstream change

In `denaidark/OhMyGithub/scripts/worker-tunnel.mjs`, add bounded retries for `start`:

- Retry only transient conditions: `408`, `425`, `429`, `500`, `502`, `503`, `504`, network errors, and timeouts.
- Do **not** retry `401`, `403`, `404`, or other permanent auth/config errors.
- Use 3 attempts with exponential backoff plus jitter, e.g. 1s, 2s, 4s.
- Ensure the server-side operation is idempotent for the same `run` + `attempt`, so a retry returns the existing tunnel rather than creating a duplicate.
- Include sanitized diagnostics in the thrown error: status, truncated response body, `cf-ray`, and `x-request-id`.
- Add tests for: `502 → 200`, `403 → no retry`, and timeout → retry.

After OhMyGithub publishes a new commit:

1. Update both reusable workflow refs in `.github/workflows/opencode.yml`:
   - `denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-prepare.yml@<new-sha>`
   - `denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-reusable.yml@<new-sha>`
2. Update both `runtime_ref:` inputs to `<new-sha>`.
3. Test with a real run and confirm the workflow reaches “Run OpenCode and locate its web session.”

### Health-check logging improvement — also OhMyGithub upstream

In the reusable workflow, log the attempt number and success explicitly:

```bash
echo "OpenCode health attempt $_/45"
...
echo "OpenCode healthy on port $OPENCODE_WEB_PORT"
```

Optionally suppress the expected first-poll curl error until the final attempt. This is diagnostic quality only, not the root cause.

---

## 5. Does the fix require OmGithub support?

**Yes, for the durable fix.**

- **OmGithub support is required** to investigate why the tunnel API returned 502 and to add retry/backoff in the centralized runtime.
- **Our repository can apply** the pinned SHA update after OhMyGithub releases the fix.
- **There is no safe repository-only code fix** for this specific step, because the failing step lives in the remote reusable workflow and centralized runtime. A caller-level workaround would be a manual rerun, not a real fix.

Useful details for support:

- Failed runs: `41209352571` at `2026-10-31T14:17:08Z` and `41216628400` at `2026-10-31T15:49:44Z`
- Successful comparison runs: `41209440734` at `14:18:26Z` and `41218607764` at `16:14:08Z`
- Endpoint: `POST https://omgithub.com/api/github/dannyleonards42-web/PlayGround/issues/<n>/tunnel`
- Symptom: HTTP 502 after roughly 2.1–2.3 seconds, before cloudflared is spawned

---

## 6. What remains uncertain

1. **Why OmGithub returned 502.** The client only sees the status. It could be an OmGithub origin restart, a Caddy/Express upstream failure, a Cloudflare API error during tunnel provisioning, or an orphaned-tunnel/reconciliation issue. Server-side logs are needed.
2. **Whether a retry would have succeeded.** Very likely, given runs #2 and #4 succeeded, but this has not been tested against a controlled 502.
3. **Whether the 502 is recurring.** Two of four runs hit it today. It may be transient, but the frequency is high enough to warrant an upstream retry.
4. **Whether OpenRouter has enough quota for the actual AGENT HQ build.** Account auth loaded `openrouter`, but run #2 later hit the free-model quota. That is a separate blocker.
5. **Whether future OpenCode releases remain compatible.** The workflow resolves the latest stable OpenCode at runtime, so v2.2.5 working today does not guarantee the next release will work.

---

**No repository files, workflow configurations, secrets, account settings, project files, or checkpoints were modified during this diagnosis.**

1073: function mergeStaticMeshes(root) {
1074:   root.updateMatrixWorld(true)
1075:   const rootInverse = new THREE.Matrix4().copy(root.matrixWorld).invert()
1076:   const buckets = new Map()
1077:   const remove = []
1078:   const meshList = []
1079: 
1080:   root.traverse((object) => {
1081:     if (!object.isMesh || object.isInstancedMesh) return
1082:     if (object.userData.keep) return
1083:     if (Array.isArray(object.material)) return
1084:     meshList.push(object)
1085:   })
1086: 
1087:   meshList.forEach((object) => {
1088:     if (!object.parent) return
1089:     const material = object.material
1090:     if (!material) return
1091:     const key = material.uuid
1092:     let bucket = buckets.get(key)
1093:     if (!bucket) {
1094:       bucket = { material, geometries: [], castShadow: false, receiveShadow: false, renderOrder: object.renderOrder }
1095:       buckets.set(key, bucket)
1096:     }
1097:     const geometry = object.geometry.index ? object.geometry.toNonIndexed() : object.geometry.clone()
1098:     const matrix = new THREE.Matrix4().multiplyMatrices(rootInverse, object.matrixWorld)
1099:     geometry.applyMatrix4(matrix)
1100:     if (!geometry.attributes.uv && bucket.material.map) {
1101:       // Keep textural materials out of the merge if they do not have UVs.
1102:       geometry.dispose()
1103:       return
1104:     }
1105:     bucket.geometries.push(geometry)
1106:     bucket.castShadow ||= object.castShadow
1107:     bucket.receiveShadow ||= object.receiveShadow
1108:     remove.push(object)
1109:   })
1110: 
1111:   remove.forEach((object) => {
1112:     object.parent?.remove(object)
1113:   })
1114: 
1115:   buckets.forEach((bucket) => {
1116:     if (!bucket.geometries.length) return
1117:     const merged = mergeGeometries(bucket.geometries, false)
1118:     if (!merged) return
1119:     const mergedMesh = new THREE.Mesh(merged, bucket.material)
1120:     mergedMesh.castShadow = bucket.castShadow
1121:     mergedMesh.receiveShadow = bucket.receiveShadow
1122:     mergedMesh.renderOrder = bucket.renderOrder || 0
1123:     mergedMesh.name = `merged-${bucket.material.uuid.slice(0, 5)}`
1124:     root.add(mergedMesh)
1125:     bucket.geometries.forEach((geometry) => geometry.dispose())
1126:   })
1127: }

const lights = addLights(scene)
  const motes = addMotes(scene)

  // Transparent pick volumes. They are intentionally excluded from the merge.
  const pickables = []
  for (const agent of AGENT_SEEDS) {
    const robot = robotParts[agent.id]
    const hit = makePickBox(scene, {
      type: 'agent',
      id: agent.id,
      label: agent.name.toUpperCase(),
      sublabel: agent.role.toUpperCase(),
      action: 'select',
      size: [0.95, 1.75, 0.9],
      position: [agent.home.x, 0.92, agent.home.z],
    })
    hit.userData.follow = robot.root
    hit.userData.followOffset = [0, 0.92, 0]
    pickables.push(hit)
    robot.hitbox = hit

    const deskOffset = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0.7).applyAxisAngle(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), agent.home.rotation)
    const deskHit = makePickBox(scene, {
      type: 'agent',
      id: agent.id,
      label: agent.name.toUpperCase(),
      sublabel: agent.role.toUpperCase(),
      action: 'select',
      size: [2.2, 1.2, 1.2],
      position: [agent.home.x + deskOffset.x, 0.55, agent.home.z + deskOffset.z],
      rotation: agent.home.rotation,
    })
    pickables.push(deskHit)
  }

  const execHit = makePickBox(scene, {
    type: 'exec',
    id: 'executive',
    label: 'EXECUTIVE CONSOLE',
    sublabel: 'OPEN OPERATIONS',
    action: 'console',
    size: [3.8, 2.4, 2.4],
    position: [-2.45, 0.8, -0.15],
  })
  pickables.push(execHit)

  const boardroomHit = makePickBox(scene, {
    type: 'boardroom',
    id: 'boardroom',
    label: 'BOARDROOM',
    sublabel: 'CONVENE STAND-UP',
    action: 'standup',
    size: [3.8, 1.6, 1.8],
    position: [7.9, 0.9, -4.16],
  })
  pickables.push(boardroomHit)

  const coffeeHit = makePickBox(scene, {
    type: 'coffee',
    id: 'coffee',
    label: 'THE BRIEF / COFFEE BAR',
    sublabel: 'POUR A CUP',
    action: 'coffee',
    size: [3.1, 1.8, 1.2],
    position: [-10.83, 0.85, 3.16],
  })
  pickables.push(coffeeHit)

  return {
    materials,
    workstations,
    boardroom,
    exec,
    lounge,
    coffee,
    details,
    platform,
    shell,
    lights,
    motes,
    robots: robotParts,
    pickables,
    interactive: {
      agents: pickables.filter((item) => item.userData.interactive.type === 'agent'),
      exec: execHit,
      boardroom: boardroomHit,
      coffee: coffeeHit,
    },
    staticRoot,
  }
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

PROJECT_DIR="$(pwd -P)"
PORT="${PORT:-3000}"
: "${OPENCODE_WEB_DIR:?OPENCODE_WEB_DIR must be set}"

[[ "$PORT" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo "PORT must be numeric: $PORT" >&2; exit 1; }

run() {
  /usr/bin/time -p "$@"
}

echo "==> Project: $PROJECT_DIR"
echo "==> Port: $PORT"

if [[ -f package.json ]]; then
  if [[ -f package-lock.json ]]; then
    run npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
  else
    run npm install --no-audit --no-fund
  fi
fi

DEPLOY_DIR="$PROJECT_DIR"
if [[ -f package.json ]] && node -e 'const p=require("./package.json"); process.exit(p.scripts && p.scripts.build ? 0 : 1)'; then
  echo "==> Building static output"
  run npm run build -- --base ./
  DEPLOY_DIR="$PROJECT_DIR/dist"
fi

[[ -f "$DEPLOY_DIR/index.html" ]] || {
  echo "Deployment output is missing index.html: $DEPLOY_DIR" >&2
  exit 1
}

echo "==> Declaring deployment output"
run node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");
const project = process.argv[1];
const directory = process.argv[2];
fs.mkdirSync(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, { recursive: true });
fs.writeFileSync(
  path.join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, "deployment-output.json"),
  JSON.stringify({ project, directory })
);
' "$PROJECT_DIR" "$DEPLOY_DIR"

echo "==> Serving $DEPLOY_DIR on 0.0.0.0:$PORT"
run python3 -m http.server "$PORT" --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory "$DEPLOY_DIR"

+    if (operations) bottom = Math.min(bottom, operations.top - 10)
+  } else {
+    if (leftRail) left = Math.max(left, leftRail.right + 18)
+    if (rightRail) right = Math.min(right, rightRail.left - 18)
+    if (operations) bottom = Math.min(bottom, operations.top - 12)
+  }
+
+  if (right - left < 240) {
+    left = 12
+    right = window.innerWidth - 12
+  }
+  if (bottom - top < 240) {
+    top = 70
+    bottom = window.innerHeight - 80
+  }
+
+  return {
+    left,
+    right,
+    top,
+    bottom,
+    width: right - left,
+    height: bottom - top,
+    cx: (left + right) / 2,
+    cy: (top + bottom) / 2,
+  }
+}
+
+function computeFittedView(viewName) {
+  const preset = viewPreset(viewName)
+  if (!preset) return null
+
+  const safe = getSafeViewport()
+  const width = window.innerWidth
+  const height = window.innerHeight
+  const fov = preset.fov
+  const direction = preset.position.clone().sub(preset.target).normalize()
+  const center = OFFICE_BOUNDS.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3())
+  center.y = 1.55
+
+  const safeNdc = {
+    left: (safe.left / width) * 2 - 1,
+    right: (safe.right / width) * 2 - 1,
+    top: 1 - (safe.top / height) * 2,
+    bottom: 1 - (safe.bottom / height) * 2,
+  }
+
+  const corners = []
+  for (const x of [OFFICE_BOUNDS.min.x, OFFICE_BOUNDS.max.x]) {
+    for (const y of [OFFICE_BOUNDS.min.y, OFFICE_BOUNDS.max.y]) {
+      for (const z of [OFFICE_BOUNDS.min.z, OFFICE_BOUNDS.max.z]) {
+        corners.push(new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z))
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  const probe = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(fov, width / height, 0.1, 160)
+  const target = center.clone()
+  let distance = 30
+
+  for (let pass = 0; pass < 4; pass += 1) {
+    probe.position.copy(target).addScaledVector(direction, distance)
+    probe.lookAt(target)
+    probe.updateMatrixWorld()
+
+    let minX = Infinity
+    let maxX = -Infinity
+    let minY = Infinity
+    let maxY = -Infinity
+    for (const corner of corners) {
+      const projected = corner.clone().project(probe)
+      minX = Math.min(minX, projected.x)
+      maxX = Math.max(maxX, projected.x)
+      minY = Math.min(minY, projected.y)
+      maxY = Math.max(maxY, projected.y)
+    }
+
+    const requiredWidth = safeNdc.right - safeNdc.left
+    const requiredHeight = safeNdc.top - safeNdc.bottom
+    const scale = Math.max((maxX - minX) / requiredWidth, (maxY - minY) / requiredHeight)
+    distance = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(distance * scale, 12, 86)
+
+    probe.position.copy(target).addScaledVector(direction, distance)
+    probe.lookAt(target)
+    probe.updateMatrixWorld()
+
+    const projectedCenter = center.clone().project(probe)
+    const centerX = (projectedCenter.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * width
+    const centerY = (-projectedCenter.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * height
+    const dx = safe.cx - centerX
+    const dy = safe.cy - centerY
+
+    if (Math.abs(dx) > 0.5 || Math.abs(dy) > 0.5) {
+      const worldPerPixel = (2 * distance * Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(fov / 2))) / height
+      const right = new THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixColumn(probe.matrixWorld, 0)
+      const up = new THREE.Vector3().setFromMatrixColumn(probe.matrixWorld, 1)
+      // Keep the orbit target on the floor plane while panning the framed
+      // office into the middle of the safe viewport.
+      up.y = 0
+      if (up.lengthSq() < 0.0001) up.set(0, 0, 1)
+      up.normalize()
+      target.addScaledVector(right, -dx * worldPerPixel)
+      target.addScaledVector(up, dy * worldPerPixel)
+      target.y = 1.55
+    }
+  }
+
+  probe.position.copy(target).addScaledVector(direction, distance)
+  probe.lookAt(target)
+  probe.updateMatrixWorld()
+
+  return {
+    position: target.clone().addScaledVector(direction, distance),
+    target: target.clone(),
+    fov,
+    distance,
+  }
+}

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Diagnose why the AGENT HQ preview appeared empty, implement/fix the premium 3D office in the existing project, and verify the populated scene in the actual preview.

## Requirements
- Detailed premium AI office: five miniature robotic agents at separate workstations (desk, computer, chair), central executive workstation, glass-walled meeting room with table/chairs, glass partitions, flooring, lighting, ceiling details, decor, white/charcoal/warm-gold theme.
- Visible AGENT HQ title, SIMULATED PROTOTYPE indicator, agent roster, activity feed, selected-agent panel.
- Useful isometric default camera; rotation, pan, zoom; iso/top-down switching.
- Agent selection shows role, current task, simulated status; visible ongoing activity.
- Inspect scene/rendering/console first; fix root cause, not a placeholder; preserve existing functionality/structure.
- Optimize for Android tablet, 6 GB RAM, Snapdragon 680.
- Run build/tests and verify actual rendered preview; do not report completion unless office, furniture, five agents and UI are visibly present.
- Do not expose credentials; do not modify secrets/account settings.

## Decisions
- Environment geometry already existed and rendered; main defect was UI-aware framing/occlusion plus missing ceiling/partition detail, not missing scene code.
- Replaced hardcoded camera presets with viewport-safe fitted views using office bounds and HUD rail geometry.
- Use camera lens offset (`camera.setViewOffset`) to center composition while keeping OrbitControls pivot at office center.
- On mobile, selecting an agent auto-focuses and lifts it above the bottom sheet; explicit iso/top switches dismiss the sheet.
- Low-power path tightened for Snapdragon 680: pixel ratio cap 1.12, cheaper shadows, 512 shadow map, fewer motes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected source and confirmed app booted: `window.__AGENT_HQ_READY__ === true`, five robots (`nova`, `atlas`, `iris`, `echo`, `onyx`), 26 scene children, ~141k triangles, 0 app console errors.
- Added ceiling perimeter/soffit, gold reveals and recessed cove lights in `src/world.js`.
- Added glass workstation partitions (`buildPartitions`) and exported them from `createWorld`.
- Added UI-aware camera fitting (`OFFICE_BOUNDS`, `getSafeViewport`, `computeFittedView`) in `src/main.js`; all five agents now project on canvas at 1440x900, 1280x800, 800x1280, and 412x915.
- Fixed runaway orbit target on narrow screens by replacing target panning with lens offset.
- Added mobile focus framing and auto-focus on selection; mobile view switches clear the selected-agent sheet.
- Restored `SIMULATED PROTOTYPE` subtitle at <=560px.
- Verified orbit, wheel zoom, right-drag pan, iso/top buttons, pause/resume, stand-up meeting, roster/feed/panel, directives, and simulation progress.
- Built successfully (`npm run build`); low-power emulation reports `lowPower: true`, pixel ratio 1.12, 5 agents, 0 errors.
- Public preview `https://live-41218607764-1.omgithub.com/` serves new dist assets and verified populated scene: all 5 agents on canvas, roster 5, feed 6, title/subtitle present, 0 errors.

### Active
- Final visual/report review; no known code blocker.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Optionally capture final tablet/phone screenshots and confirm public preview once more after any last polish.
2. Report exact changes and verification results, noting the environment was present but occluded/misframed rather than absent.
3. If further polish is desired, consider making the portrait phone diorama larger by cropping outer floor edges; current 412px view is complete but small.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: renderer, fitted camera/lens offset, focus logic, boot, resize, low-power path.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/world.js`: office geometry, new ceiling details/glass partitions, low-power shadows/motes.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/styles.css`: HUD/layout, responsive rules, mobile subtitle fix.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui.js`: roster, feed, agent panel, camera view state.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/simulation.js`: five agent seeds, tasks, movement, meeting/feed logic.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/dist/`: built preview output served publicly.
- `/tmp/opencode/shots/`: verification screenshots including `public-final-1440.png`, `final-412-onyx.png`, `final-412-top2.png`.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted/untracked; project files were already untracked before edits. Do not discard unrelated work.
- Preview server: `python3 -m http.server 3000 --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory dist`; public tunnel serves the same `dist/`.
- Current metrics desktop: ~265 draw calls, ~141,502 triangles; low-power: 263 draw calls, 141,310 triangles.
- Camera fit reserves safe area between HUD rails; desktop allows 88px rail overlap so outer floor tucks under panels while key content stays visible.
- Mobile selected-agent focus uses `camera.setViewOffset` with desired agent Y above `#agent-panel`; distance 14.5 on <=900px, 10.8 otherwise.
- Synthetic pointer-event tests can throw `setPointerCapture` errors; use real Playwright mouse commands instead.
- Build warning only: chunk >500 kB; not a failure.
